captures.name: overview
captures.title: Start here: is the fleet healthy?
captures.body: One control room for every Claude Code session you run. These tiles answer the first question before you touch anything — what is live, what is stuck, which machines are up.

captures.name: sessions
captures.title: Sessions — where the work happens
captures.body: Every run you have started, grouped by what it needs from you. The ones blocked on an answer rise to the top, so a long fleet still reads in one glance.

captures.name: accounts
captures.title: Accounts — where the quota comes from
captures.body: Provider accounts are grouped into pools, and a session draws from a pool rather than a fixed account, so one hitting a rate limit steps aside instead of stalling the queue.

captures.name: access
captures.title: Access — what may run work
captures.body: Machines supply the compute, and they join the fleet from here with a single enrolment command. If a session cannot find anywhere to run, this is the page to open.

captures.name: guides
captures.title: Now walk it for real
captures.body: That is every screen. The remaining guides run inside the app, pointing at the real controls in order — connect an account, enrol a machine, start a session, follow it. They all live on this page.
